Population increased in County Durham

The estimated population of County Durham in 2024 was 538,011 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that County Durham's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of County Durham increased by 3.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, County Durham was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of County Durham

The average (median) age fell to 43.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of County Durham has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
County Durham is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, County Durham's population of 538,011 usual residents was made up of:

  • 88,221 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.4%)
  • 332,052 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.7%)
  • 117,738 people aged 65 years and over, (21.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, County Durham has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In County Durham, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in County Durham
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for County Durham, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,596 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 4,541 births and 6,137 deaths in County Durham.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,373 (0.4%). There were 27,750 people entering the area and 25,377 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in County Durham's population of 3,212 (0.6%) as a result of 6,038 people entering the area and 2,826 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for County Durham was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of County Durham in mid-2023 is 533,997.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,494 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 321 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,815 people.
